103:3.text: and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth
[i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma‘ruf) which Allâh has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar which Allâh has forbidden]
, and recommend one another to patience
(for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allâh’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islâmic Monotheism or Jihâd)

104:1.text: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.

104:2.text: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.

104:3.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

104:4.text: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

104:5.text: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?

104:7.text: Which leaps up over the hearts,

104:8.text: Verily, it shall be closed upon them,

104:9.text: (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars)

105:1.text: not seen how your Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
[The Elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka‘bah at Makkah]

105:2.text: Did He not make their plot go astray?

105:3.text: And He sent against them birds, in flocks,

105:4.text: Striking them with stones of Sijjîl

105:5.text: (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle)
